name: Add flat channel
summary:
Add a flat channel to a mne/raw file.
This helps add a missing channel before concatenation.
description: Creates a zero-valued channel with the given name and type at the recording's sampling rate, appends it to the raw MEG/EEG data with raw.add_channels, and saves the result with an HTML report listing the channels. Use it to add a missing stimulus or placeholder channel so that recordings can be concatenated or share the same channel layout. The new channel contains no signal.

inputs.description: Continuous MEG/EEG recording in MNE raw .fif format.

outputs.description: Raw data (raw.fif) with the added flat channel.

parameters.description: Name of the channel to add.
Type of the channel to add.
